findings.title: Identity cwd normalization
findings.body: Auditor confirmed resolve_execution_identity (identity.py) and _normalize_alias (identity_registry.py) share one normalize_path_alias_value helper, so a relative or symlinked cwd now matches its registered absolute alias.

findings.title: canonical_identity_summary schema completeness
findings.body: Auditor confirmed the summary now emits actor_id/client_id/aliases matching schemas/mcp/resolved-execution-identity.schema.json exactly, with no extra keys.

findings.title: Mount evidence fail-closed
findings.body: Auditor confirmed inspect_container_mounts (docker_inspect.py) now requires source and dest, rejecting one-sided mount evidence.

findings.title: Git-missing-binary test hardening (x2)
findings.body: Auditor confirmed both flagged tests (test_mcp_multiproject_contracts.py::test_no_runtime_effect_diff, test_fleet_catalog_v2_runtime.py::test_live_catalog_files_are_untouched_by_this_packet) now catch FileNotFoundError/OSError and skip gracefully.

findings.title: Docstring typo
findings.body: Auditor confirmed legacy_client_placement's accidental fourth leading quote is removed.
